title: Brazil's Land and Water
text:
Brazil is a big country in South America. The Amazon is a very large river. It is in the north of Brazil. Many animals live in the forest near the river.

The south of Brazil is cooler. Some places there have snow in winter. The coast is long, and many people go to the beach. The capital of Brazil is Brasília.
